data.gender_notes: Bradan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Irish name Bran, meaning raven. In Irish mythology, the raven was a symbol of the gods and represented wisdom and protection. The name Bradan carries the meaning “Little Raven” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bradan usually hope their child will grow to embody little raven and live with faith, good character and purpose.
